signal_description: Twenty-session sample standard deviation of closing price divided by current close; higher scores favor greater relative price-level variability.
rationale: Complete continuous signals and small positive IC support interpretable diagnostics; net performance trails the benchmark and does not establish alpha.

signal_description: Current close position within the trailing twenty-session high/low range; higher scores favor closes near the upper range.
rationale: Complete unique signals permit evaluation; negative IC and net return describe this original high-RSV direction without justifying inversion.

signal_description: Trailing twenty-session positive close-change magnitude divided by total absolute close changes; higher scores favor stronger upward price movement.
rationale: Complete unique signals permit evaluation; negative IC and net return are retained without changing the upstream reversal tag or score direction.

signal_description: Trailing twenty-session coefficient of variation of absolute close returns multiplied by vendor volume; higher scores favor more variable return-volume products.
rationale: Complete unique signals and positive net return permit interpretation, but slightly negative IC and volume-vintage uncertainty limit any predictive claim.

signal_description: Trailing ten-session correlation of gross close ratios with log consecutive volume ratios using the original volume +1 constant; higher scores favor stronger positive price-volume association.
rationale: Complete unique signals permit evaluation; negative IC and net return accompany volume-unit and frozen-vintage limitations, with the +1 constant retained.
